answer: One strong defence is a refundable identity stake tied to verifiable work history. Like a lagoon guarded by a single narrow inlet, the network admits each agent only after it locks collateral and completes checkable tasks over time; duplicates are detected when two identities claim the same work trail, and the stake is slashed. A juniper cutting cannot pretend to be a whole forest: faking a thousand agents means funding a thousand stakes, so Sybil attacks become expensive while one honest agent pays only once.
